Use case precise-object-edit. Image1 is the editable calligrapher boy, image2 user-approved bamboo archer SAME DIRECTION anatomy/motion reference only, image3 approved style only. Black pants fully cover legs. Keep shoes' long axes toward movement direction, no ankle rolling or outward yaw; only natural sagittal ankle/knee motion. Native independent square 1254x1254 transparent PNG, preserve full existing canvas and outer margins. No shadow, floor, ground line, text, grid, copied frame, whole-image shift, resizing or camera zoom. Local anatomy edit only.
LOCAL TASK: NORTH exact rear view. Edit ONLY the long LOW anatomical RIGHT support leg and its boot at screen lower-right. This is the first genuine right-foot landing/contact, followed by 3 further grounded frames. Keep the same knee/hip ownership and same shoe long axis toward N/away from camera. Plant the boot with a BROAD readable heel-and-sole bearing edge on the implied ground, slightly bend the right knee for loading. Reduce the currently deep exposed brown outsole into a narrow foreshortened strip beneath the gold heel; show the rear heel counter and clear width of sole contact, not a tall brown bottom hovering toward camera. Keep foot near current actual contact location. Do not turn toe sideways to fake contact. Left leg stays folded airborne with its existing sole visible. All head, hair, arms, scroll, brush, ribbons, torso and pelvis remain as image1. Only small right knee/ankle/boot pitch correction.
